requirements_summary:
Workloads: conversational chat (user-facing) and real-time reranking for trading signals.
Latency targets: p50 10–20ms, p95 <30ms, p99 <50ms (sequence lengths 64–512 tokens).
Throughput: spiky 800–1,200 QPS with sustained 250–500 QPS.
Cost sensitivity: must validate quantization (8-bit/4-bit) impact on latency and quality; want per-token cost delta.
Benchmarks requested: end-to-end tail latency under production-like load, throughput under batching profiles, cold vs warm KV cache impact, memory footprint on deduced GPU variants.
Operational: SSO/Okta, KMS integration, audit logs surfaced in Console, EU data residency for sensitive PII, retention controls.
Routing: want routing policy that prefers cheaper quantized variant for non-critical routes and falls back to full-precision for priority flows.
POC success metrics: meet p99 <50ms for chat at 500 QPS with <=15% quality regression when using quantized models; cost reduction >=30% vs baseline.
